note: golden_hash and output_payload filled by `node golden-parity.test.mjs --update`. Vectors cover both modes -- valuing a basket from amounts already fixed at a rebase date, and deriving those amounts from target weights on a transition date -- plus the integer-quantity scale path, the parent-print citation path, and the two error paths (weights that do not sum to one, and missing rates).

vectors.name: fixed-amount-valuation-five-currency
vectors.description: Five-currency basket valued from amounts fixed at a rebase date. Weights float with FX, so each component's live weight is derived from its USD contribution rather than declared.

not_proven.detail: Every usd_rate is caller-supplied and asserted. This kernel performs no FX, reference-rate or market-data lookups (zero-egress) and does not verify any rate against a published fixing for the stated date.

Fixed amounts and target weights are caller-supplied. This kernel does not verify that a stated composition matches any published basket, nor that a preset remains current -- a basket reviewed on a periodic cycle changes on its own schedule.
The index value computed here is what the fixed-amount method yields on the supplied rates. It is not a claim that any basket administrator did, or would, publish this value for this date.
Where per-pair rates are cited from upstream oracle prints, this kernel records the citation but does not verify that those prints are current, in-epoch, or drawn from the same observation window.

output_payload.fence: Every FX rate, fixed amount and target weight is SUPPLIED, asserted, and digested into this receipt. This kernel computes what the fixed-amount basket method yields on the stated numbers: it performs no FX or reference-rate lookups (zero-egress by contract), does not verify any rate against a published fixing, and makes no claim that any administrator did or would publish this value.

vectors.name: derive-amounts-from-target-weights
vectors.description: Transition-date derivation: target weights plus the rebase-date FX rates yield the fixed amounts, which are then valued at today's rates. This is the non-obvious arithmetic the node owns -- amounts are an output of the rebase, not an input to it.

vectors.name: weights-do-not-sum-to-one
vectors.description: Error path: target weights sum to 0.9 rather than 1, so the derivation is refused rather than silently normalized. A basket derived from weights that do not sum to one is not a basket.

output_payload.structural_error: target weights must sum to 1 within 0.001; supplied sum is 0.9.

vectors.name: structural-error-missing-rates
vectors.description: Error path: a component is missing its usd_rate and another supplies a non-positive rate, so every rejection is recorded with its pointer and the supplied value rather than being coerced to a default.

output_payload.structural_error: every component requires a currency and a positive usd_rate.

rejected_inputs.reason: absent or not a finite number -- the USD value of one unit of this currency is required
